## Why it matters

Duke's Ad*Access provides digitized advertisements from U.S. and Canadian periodicals, centered on beauty, radio, television, transportation, and World War II propaganda.

It is useful for studying consumer culture, visual rhetoric, gender, technology, and wartime messaging across the first half of the twentieth century.
